|game_text=If you have no Epic Events on table (and did not play an Epic Even at the start of the game), deploy on table. Once per game, may take a [Setup] card into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. May place this Effect in Used Pile to take an Immediate Effect into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. May place this Effect in Lost Pile to cancel a Force drain. (Immune to [[Alter]].)
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Luke, Trust Me]], the text of the PC website card list. Other versions: [[Luke, Trust Me]] (original), [[Luke, Trust Me (Errata)]] (PC-E1), [[Luke, Trust Me (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3) and [[Luke, Trust Me (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4, the current text). No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB7-03-Luke_Trust_Me-PC-E2-cardmaker.png]]; renamed on 11 November 2026 when the versions were put in date order). How these versions came about (Holotable data, the PC website card list, the Master List and the PC card images) is told in [[PC Legacy Virtual Transcription Error History]].
* '''Original''' ([[Luke, Trust Me]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet (official text as of 18 June 2010): “Unless your Epic Event on table, deploy on table. Once per game, may ▲ a [Setup] card. May place this Effect in Used Pile to ▲ an Immediate Effect. May place this Effect in Lost Pile to cancel a Force drain. (Immune to Alter.)”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf#page=7 Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 18 June 2010"; copy re-made 28 July 2010), page 7, slip 39 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf#page=7 Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Luke, Trust Me (Errata)]]): The Players Committee posted this errata on its rules forum on 19 January 2012, as an addition to Appendix A of the Advanced Rulebook<ref name="pcforum-p676488">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 19 January 2012 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=40#p676488 forum post])</ref>. It changed “Unless your Epic Event on table,” to “If you have no Epic Events on table (and did not play an Epic Event at the start of the game),”, because the card was not meant to work with decks that start an Epic Event (the post writes the Setup icon as “[Starting]”): “If you have no Epic Events on table (and did not play an Epic Event at the start of the game), deploy on table. Once per game, may ▲ a [Setup] card. May place this Effect in Used Pile to ▲ an Immediate Effect. May place this Effect in Lost Pile to cancel a Force drain. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) printed “an Epic Even at the start” (typo as published); no other word changed (the card list writes the ▲ icons out as “take … into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”, which alone is not a version): “If you have no Epic Events on table (and did not play an Epic Even at the start of the game), deploy on table. Once per game, may take a [Setup] card into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. May place this Effect in Used Pile to take an Immediate Effect into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. May place this Effect in Lost Pile to cancel a Force drain. (Immune to Alter.)”<ref name="cl-1271_39-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Luke, Trust Me (Errata 3)]]): The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-luketrustme-pre.gif]], marked E; on the Players Committee's server by 25 February 2013<ref name="pc-img-date">Players Committee card image folder (<code>Virtual7-Light/large/</code>), web-server directory listing sorted by date: <code>luketrustme.gif</code> last modified 25 February 2013, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034736/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/?C=M;O=A 18 August 2019] (Internet Archive); the file is byte-identical to today's.</ref>): “If you have no Epic Events on table (and did not play an Epic Event at the start of the game), deploy on table. Once per game, may ▲ a [Setup] card. May place this Effect in Used Pile to ▲ an Immediate Effect. May place this Effect in Lost Pile to cancel a Force drain. (Immune to Alter.)” It prints the PC-E1 forum text again, word for word. A Players Committee card image is a version of its own, placed at its date, even when its words repeat an earlier version (versions ruling of 11 November 2026, 09:14). Its date is the folder's bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; the version order follows that date (versions ruling of 11 November 2026, 08:45). The card image shows the card's art, prints the errata mark E bottom right and no slip number.
* '''PC-E4''' ([[Luke, Trust Me (Errata 4)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 26)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=26, page 26. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=26 Internet Archive]</ref> prints the PC-E1 forum text again, word for word: “If you have no Epic Events on table (and did not play an Epic Event at the start of the game), deploy on table. Once per game, may ▲ a [Setup] card. May place this Effect in Used Pile to ▲ an Immediate Effect. May place this Effect in Lost Pile to cancel a Force drain. (Immune to Alter.)” Every published text is a version, even a word-for-word repeat (versions ruling of 11 November 2026), so the Master List is listed as PC-E4. It is the last published text, so it is the current text. The Master List slip leaves the art box blank and prints the errata mark E, with no slip number.
